task: D38 hand sweep feedback and interruption retention
scope: Replace demonstrated square colored hand-card backing with thin rounded state outlines
Preserve applied selection on implicit interruption and safely recover physical pointer ownership
invariants: No rules, RNG, command/save format, artwork, dependencies or deployment changes.

baseline.cause: Same held sweep: edgeGlow-off retains square colored patches; changing only the 4px Rectangle stroke to a thin neutral edge removes them. Raw Canvas and full-page screenshots agree; checkmarks, lift, selected set and exported controller state unchanged.
baseline.departure: Native mouse/CDP touch reproduce one selected -> live five -> one after old cancellation on hand/viewport exit and reentry.
baseline.nativeTapHighlight: UNCONFIRMED. CSS-only transparent tap highlight did not remove demonstrated Canvas artifact. Stationary screenshot round trips exceeded the long-press threshold; no claim of sub-threshold or physical-phone reproduction.
baseline.setupFailure: One isolated diagnostic clicked shop entry during its readiness transition; corrected by waiting actual ready state, without changing timeout. Failed attempt retained in baseline/isolation-setup-failure.json.

behavior.implicit: Hand/viewport exit, capture loss, pointercancel, multi-contact, blur/hidden, modal and resize/reset preserve already-applied set and end tracking. Pending taps/holds never acquire a card on interruption.
behavior.physical: Leave/capture loss retain suppression until corresponding up/cancel; same-type fresh primary or same-ID mouse/pen zero-button return recover a missed release. Other types/nonprimary contacts do not prove release.
behavior.explicitEscape: Restores gesture starting snapshot and consumes subsequent release.
behavior.feedback: Neutral 1px base edge; thin rounded red/jade selection/scoring contour and visible gold hover/focus. Lift, checkmark, scoring symbol and keyboard focus preserved.

browser.fpsNote: Read from Phaser at a single functional checkpoint, not a hardware or physical-device performance benchmark.
browser.inputNotes: Mouse/CDP touch native events. Capture-release API and dispatched blur are labelled lifecycle injections; missed physical release recovery additionally covered by isolated input unit tests.

releaseAggregate.smoke: Canvas desktop1280x720 and touch390x740/DPR3, external system-Chromium adapter. No assertion/timeout changes.
releaseAggregate.documentationAfterGate: Only this result and handoff were finalized after the frozen aggregate; runtime/test/harness hashes rechecked unchanged, then plan/diff checked.

nativePan.scope: Same frozen bundle, native CDP touch creates trusted pointercancel and scroll 0 to 93px. Production app overflow:hidden; explicitly labelled browser-local scrolling scaffold exercises browser-owned pan without injected cancellation.
nativePan.result: Selection and complete persisted state remain unchanged; contact/capture/owner clear, input restores, next tap works.
